templates.description: Search input with icon and suggestions on focus.

templates.name: TypeaheadWithHelperText
templates.description: Typeahead with a description below the label.

templates.name: TypeaheadWithValidation
templates.description: Typeahead with an error validation message.

templates.name: TypeaheadItemShowcase
templates.description: Typeahead with custom item rendering using TypeaheadItem for avatars and descriptions.

templates.name: TypeaheadItemBasic
templates.description: A typeahead whose results are rendered with TypeaheadItem, adding a secondary description below each label. Use inside renderItem to keep custom results visually consistent.

templates.name: AnimatorPlayingCards
templates.description: A playing card that follows a drag: a gentle release springs it back on its release velocity, and a quick flick throws it away with momentum before the next card is dealt. A Discard button moves it off from the keyboard, fading it in place under Reduce Motion, and the discard is announced. Built only on the public useAnimator hook.

templates.name: useAnnounceHookUsage
templates.description: A product filter that announces its result count with useAnnounce: once typing pauses for 500 ms, a screen reader hears "3 results" or "No results". The count has its own hasReplace instance, as the hook's docs advise for a changing value.

templates.name: AppShellMobileHookUsage
templates.description: Custom mobile navigation trigger built with useAppShellMobile. The trigger consumes the surrounding AppShell context instead of rendering its own shell.

templates.name: useCalendarConstraintsHookUsage
templates.description: A hotel booking range picker enforcing season min/max dates, a 7-night maximum stay once check-in is picked, and a custom rule disabling closed Mondays.

templates.name: useCalendarDaysHookUsage
templates.description: A compact custom month view: a seven-column table built from the weeks and dayNames that useCalendarDays returns, with only as many rows as the month needs. Days from the previous and next months are dimmed, and a Week starts on control (Sunday or Monday) reorders both the header and the grid.

templates.name: useCalendarNavigationHookUsage
templates.description: A calendar month pager with previous/next navigation buttons, localized month-year label, and cross-month arrow key navigation using pendingFocus.

templates.name: useClickableContainerHookUsage
templates.description: A project card that useClickableContainer makes clickable anywhere: a click on the card follows its title link, while the Star button, the owner link and a text selection keep their own behavior, and Ctrl/Cmd+click or middle-click opens the project in a new tab.

templates.name: useClipboardHookUsage
templates.description: A share card that copies its invite link with useClipboard: the Copy button reads "Copied" while isCopied is true, a screen reader hears "Link copied", and a second press restarts the reset timer.

templates.name: CollapsibleHookUsage
templates.description: Custom disclosure UI built directly with useCollapsible for headless open/close state.

templates.name: useCollatorHookUsage
templates.description: A list of names sorted with the compare function from useCollator: accented and lowercase names land where a reader expects, and switching the provider locale to Swedish moves Å and Ö after Z.

templates.name: useComboboxHookUsage
templates.description: An "Assign to" TextInput and a list of Item rows, with the field, listbox and option props from useCombobox spread onto them: typing filters a list of teammates, ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the active option while focus stays in the input, Enter picks it and Escape closes the list.

templates.name: useContainerRevealHookUsage
templates.description: File rows keep their edit/delete actions hidden at rest and reveal them on hover or keyboard focus via useContainerReveal; the actions stay mounted and in the tab order.

templates.name: DragToSnapPointsCard
templates.description: A playing card that a sideways drag moves between three places: a slow release settles on the nearest, a quick flick carries to the next, and a release moving back returns where it started. Buttons settle it from the keyboard, and the new place is announced. Built only on the public useDragToSnapPoints hook.
templates._displayName: useDragToSnapPoints — Playing card on three places

templates.name: useFocusTrapHookUsage
templates.description: A custom quick-edit panel, not built on Dialog, that traps focus with useFocusTrap: focusFirst moves focus to its field on open, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it, Escape closes it through onEscape, and closing returns focus to the Quick edit button.

templates.name: useGridFocusHookUsage
templates.description: A color swatch picker in rows of eight with one Tab stop. useGridFocus moves focus with the arrow keys, Home and End, and Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End. Each swatch is a button, so Enter or a click picks it.

templates.name: useHotkeysHookUsage
templates.description: Page shortcuts registered with useHotkeys: "/" focuses the search field and "?" opens the shortcut help, while typing either character in the field just types it. A switch turns the single-key shortcuts off through isDisabled.

templates.name: HoverCardHookUsage
templates.description: Custom profile preview using useHoverCard with direct trigger and render control.

templates.name: useIconHookUsage
templates.description: A custom status row that draws the semantic success, warning and error icons with useIcon. The same row renders under the current theme and under a Theme whose icons override those three, and its icons change with no change to the component.

templates.name: useImageModeHookUsage
templates.description: A photo banner with a caption over the sky. useImageMode samples only the strip under the caption and MediaTheme switches the caption between light and dark text from the result. A Beach photo switch swaps a night photo for a bright beach photo, and while the new photo loads the caption keeps the dark fallback.

templates.name: useInputContainerHookUsage
templates.description: A custom search field wrapper with a leading search icon, padding and a trailing Clear button. useInputContainer puts focus in the input when the icon or the padding is clicked, while a click on Clear empties the field without the wrapper taking it over.

templates.name: useInputStatusIconHookUsage
templates.description: A custom bordered coupon-code input whose status affordance comes from useInputStatusIcon. A wrong code shows the error status and SAVE20 shows success. Switching the variant moves between a plain glyph with a message below (attached), no icon on the field (detached), and a focusable button whose tooltip keyboard and screen-reader users can reach, with its aria-describedby id returned by the hook (tooltip).

templates.name: useInteractiveRoleHookUsage
templates.description: A polymorphic Tile used four ways: with an href it renders as a link, with an onClick as a button, with neither as plain content, and placed as a Popover trigger it becomes the trigger button through context — the resolution order in one place.

templates.name: useKeyboardHintHookUsage
templates.description: A custom five-star rating with one Tab stop calls useKeyboardHint directly: tabbing into it shows a "← → to navigate" hint, the first arrow press dismisses it, and tabbing back in does not show it again.

templates.name: LayerHookUsage
templates.description: Low-level anchored overlay rendered with useLayer and a custom surface.

templates.name: LightboxHookUsage
templates.description: Photo gallery thumbnail grid using useLightbox for trigger props, keyboard navigation, and open state.

templates.name: useLinkComponentHookUsage
templates.description: A custom Article card renders its title link with the component useLinkComponent resolves: the as prop first, then the nearest LinkProvider, then a native anchor. Inside a LinkProvider wired to a client-side router, the title navigates without a page load and updates the router location. With as="a" the title is a native anchor even inside the provider, and outside the provider it falls back to the next provider up or a native anchor.

templates.name: useLinkifyHookUsage
templates.description: Plain-text comments where useLinkify turns the URL and the email address into Links, and a custom pattern turns issue references like #123 into tracker links — the patterns option in action. The comment without matches stays plain text.
templates._displayName: useLinkify — Links in a Comment Thread

templates.name: useListFocusHookUsage
templates.description: A "Recent files" list of buttons with keyboard navigation from useListFocus: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move between rows, Home and End jump to the first and last row, focus wraps at the ends, and only one row is in the tab order.

templates.name: useLocaleHookUsage
templates.description: An invoice summary that formats its date and amount with Intl using the locale from useLocale, so switching the provider from English to German changes "Nov 2, 2026" and "$1,234.50" to "2. Nov. 2026" and "1.234,50 $" with no second locale source.

templates.name: useMergedRefsHookUsage
templates.description: An AutoGrowTextArea that forwards the caller's ref and also keeps its own ref to measure scrollHeight. The merged ref attaches both to the same textarea: it resizes itself while a parent button focuses it through the forwarded ref.

templates.name: useMultiComboboxHookUsage
templates.description: A Labels field built on useMultiCombobox: typing filters the labels, the arrow keys move the active option while focus stays in the field, Enter or a click toggles a label and the list stays open, and selected labels show as removable tokens above the field.

templates.name: useOutlineFromMarkdownHookUsage
templates.description: A docs-style article with an Outline next to it, built from the same Markdown string through useOutlineFromMarkdown. "Add section" appends a heading to the string, and a new entry that links to it appears in the outline.

templates.name: useOverflowHookUsage
templates.description: Resize the card: useOverflow moves the toolbar actions that do not fit into a More menu, and shows them again when the card gets wider.

templates.name: useOverlayHookUsage
templates.description: A product card that is its own overlay container: useOverlay returns the ref and props to spread on the Card and a bottom strip to render once over the image. Hovering the card, or moving keyboard focus into it, slides in a Quick view button along the bottom of the image, and leaving hides it again. The image is a link that the strip leaves clickable above it, and Tab lands on it first so the next Tab reaches Quick view.

templates.name: PanDraggableBox
templates.description: The smallest pan example, in two forms side by side: the usePanGesture hook and the createPanGesture factory. The factory takes any element, React or not. Each card names its API, follows a drag from a finger, a mouse or a pen, and springs back, with the same StyleX styles. A starting point for a draggable tile, a swipe or any drag-and-release gesture.

templates.name: PanPlayingCard
templates.description: An advanced usePanGesture example: a playing card follows a drag, settles back on a gentle release and flies off on a quick flick, while a Discard button deals the next card from the keyboard and announces it. Drag, settle and throw are StyleX styles driven by React state. A pattern for swipe-to-dismiss, card decks and flick gestures.

templates.name: PopoverHookUsage
templates.description: Custom quick-actions popover using usePopover for trigger refs, ARIA attributes, and focus trapping.

templates.name: usePowerSearchConfigHookUsage
templates.description: A people directory with a PowerSearch bar over a Table: typed field definitions feed usePowerSearchConfig, returning the search config and an applyFilters helper that updates Table rows.

templates.name: usePressFeedbackHookUsage
templates.description: A Card made pressable with usePressFeedback: its marker and the interactionOverlayStyles backgroundImage overlay go straight on the Card, so a press darkens the card the way every Astryx pressable does; focusOutlineStyles.focusVisible gives it the shared Astryx focus ring for keyboard focus; and a click, Enter or Space flips it.

templates.name: useScrollableAreaHookUsage
templates.description: A fixed-height Activity log panel whose entries scroll up and down. useScrollableArea makes the panel a keyboard tab stop only when its entries overflow, reports which edges have more entries so a top or bottom shadow shows only there, and keeps a scroll that reaches the end from scrolling the page. Add entry flips the panel from not scrollable to scrollable.

templates.name: useScrollLockHookUsage
templates.description: A custom full-screen menu opened from a Menu button. useScrollLock pins the page behind it while it is open, so the page does not scroll or shift sideways, and closing the menu returns the reader to the same scroll position.

templates.name: useScrollOverflowHookUsage
templates.description: A row of active filters that scrolls sideways. useScrollOverflow reports which edge has hidden filters, and the strip fades only that edge: none while every filter fits, the end at the start, both mid-scroll and the start at the end. Adding or removing a filter updates the fades, and in a right-to-left layout the start edge is on the right.

templates.name: CarouselSnapPaging
templates.description: Onboarding cards in a Carousel with hasSnap={useSnapPaging()}: under a finger or a trackpad swipe, each flick moves one view and rests on a card's start edge. A switch picks one view or one card per flick through the hook's pages option.

templates.name: useStreamingTextHookUsage
templates.description: A chat-style reply card: while the response streams in bursts, useStreamingText reveals it steadily character by character; when streaming ends the full text snaps into place. Regenerate replays the stream.

templates.name: ColumnResizeHookUsage
templates.description: A Table using useTableColumnResize. Drag the right edge of any column header to resize; widths are committed on release. The last proportional column flexes to fill remaining space.

templates.name: useTableColumnSettingsStateHookUsage
templates.description: A Table toolbar with a Columns menu of checkboxes: toggling Email updates active columns, Reset restores defaults, and the config is passed directly to useTableColumnSettings.

templates.name: TableGroupedRowsTable
templates.description: A table grouped into collapsible sections with useTableGroupedRows. Each group gets a full-width header with a chevron, label, and member count; click to collapse/expand.

templates.name: TableRowExpansionTable
templates.description: A tree table using useTableRowExpansion with inherited columns. Child rows use the same columns as parents, indented by depth. Click the chevron or right-click to expand/collapse.

templates.name: TableRowIndexTable
templates.description: A table with a prepended row-number column via useTableRowIndex. Numbering is monospaced, right-aligned, and follows the rows the table renders.

templates.name: TableRowStatusTable
templates.description: A job table using both row-status paths: status resolves themed semantic glyphs and tones, while color stays a custom paint choice with an optional caller-selected icon or the stable dot.

templates.name: RowsVirtualizationHookUsage
templates.description: A Table with 1,000 product rows in a fixed-height viewport. Scroll vertically to mount the visible rows. The caller keeps all data and columns; this hook does not virtualize columns.

templates.name: useTableSortableStateHookUsage
templates.description: Orders with no sort code of their own: useTableSortableState owns the sort state, returns the sorted orders, and hands useTableSortable a ready config. Click Customer, then Shift-click Total, to sort by customer and then by total within each customer. A line above the orders reads the current sort state from the hook.

templates.name: StickyColumnsHookUsage
templates.description: A Table using useTableStickyColumns to pin the Name column to the start edge and Status to the end edge. Scroll horizontally; pinned columns stay in view with a soft shadow over the scrolling content.

templates.name: TableTreeTable
templates.description: A file-tree table built from nested data. useTableTreeState flattens the tree into the visible rows and owns the expanded set; useTableTreeData draws the per-level indent and the expand/collapse chevron in the tree column. The two hooks are designed to work together, so this one example covers both. hasExpandAllControl adds the expand-all/collapse-all toggle to the tree column header. Collapsed branches are unmounted, not hidden.

templates.name: useThemeHookUsage
templates.description: Read resolved theme token values with useTheme for non-CSS consumers like SVG charts.

templates.name: useToastHookUsage
templates.description: Shows a toast from the function useToast returns: a "Settings saved" confirmation with an Undo action, a uniqueID so pressing the button again replaces the toast instead of stacking another, and an error toast when the request fails.

templates.name: useTranslatorHookUsage
templates.description: A "Load more" footer under a list that gets its button label and its "Showing 3 of 9" count from the function useTranslator returns, with app message keys supplied per locale through InternationalizationProvider, so switching the provider to French changes both strings.

templates.name: useTreeFocusHookUsage
templates.description: A custom file tree built from plain rows with tree roles. useTreeFocus gives it the WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move over the visible rows, ArrowRight opens a folder or moves into it, ArrowLeft closes it or moves to its parent, Home and End jump to the ends, a typed letter jumps to a matching name, Enter opens a file, and only one row is in the tab order.

templates.name: useTypeaheadHookUsage
templates.description: A country list of buttons with useListFocus arrow keys and useTypeahead type-to-focus. Typing "can" focuses Canada, pressing "b" again and again cycles through Belgium, Brazil and Bulgaria, and "e" finds Éire with the accent ignored. The hook only reports the match through onMatch, and useListFocus moves focus.
templates._displayName: useTypeahead — Type to Focus a Country

templates.name: form-wizard-vertical
templates.description: Multi-step wizard with the steps in a fixed left rail that stays visible while the form scrolls, plus a side panel whose guidance follows the focused field. Suits long or unequal steps carrying uploads, previews, and dense review metadata. As width tightens the guidance drops first, then the rail rotates into a horizontal stepper above the form.

templates.name: VisuallyHiddenLiveRegion
templates.description: A polite aria-live region announces visual-only state changes to assistive technology.

templates.name: VisuallyHiddenStructuralHeading
templates.description: Give a visually implicit section an accessible name so screen-reader users can navigate to it.

templates.name: VisuallyHiddenSupplementaryContext
templates.description: Stat cards whose trend arrows get screen-reader-only text, so a change like +12% is read as an increase from last month. Use to make terse visual data accessible.

templates.name: VStackShowcase
templates.description: Demonstrates VStack arranging items vertically with different gaps.

templates.name: VStackBasic
templates.description: A heading and paragraphs stacked vertically with a consistent gap. Use VStack whenever siblings should flow top to bottom with even spacing.

templates.name: DrawerWidths
templates.description: Compare a numeric pixel width with rem and percentage lengths. The width budget also caps the drawer on mobile.
templates._displayName: Width budget: pixels or any CSS length

templates.name: DrawerHeaderWithCloseButton
templates.description: Pass onOpenChange to render a close button that calls it with false. Drawer renders no close button of its own, so this is the usual visible way to close.

templates.name: DrawerHeaderSubtitleEndContent
templates.description: Add a subtitle under the title and put a status, such as a Badge, in endContent. The close button stays at the end of the row.

templates.name: work-item-detail
templates.description: Single work-item detail in two columns: a title with a status selector, a description, a subtask checklist with progress, an attachments block, and a comment and activity feed in the main column, plus a property rail with assignee, dates, labels, and linked items. The shape for any tracked item with children, properties, and a comment history — a task, ticket, issue, story, bug, card, request, or work item.

themes.name: butter
themes.description: Warm, creamy yellows with a friendly blue accent. Playful enough for consumer surfaces, soft enough to stay readable.

themes.name: chocolate
themes.description: Warm chocolate theme for Astryx — rich brown palette with Fraunces headings, Albert Sans body, and Lucide icons

themes.name: gothic
themes.description: Deep blue-grays and a signature display serif. Dramatic and editorial, for surfaces that want to be remembered.

themes.name: matcha
themes.description: Earthy greens with a calm, organic feel. Naturalistic and grounded, great for wellness or content-first apps.

themes.name: neutral
themes.description: Restrained warm grays. Minimal and quiet, so the content stays the focus.

themes.name: stone
themes.description: Warm stone and slate, earthy and understated, with just enough character to feel handcrafted.

themes.name: y2k
themes.description: Hot pinks, lime greens, and Poppins. Bubbly, playful, and unmistakably retro.
